credits.doc: M5-A3P-1700 (act3_ending CR, 7 min; ADR 0207): the closing credits roll. `sections` are shown top to bottom, each a title_key and lines (loc keys), with section_gap px between sections and line_gap px between lines (1920 x 1080 reference). The roll lasts `roll_sec` (the credits_suite cue's length, less the vignettes' hold), from lead_in_sec of black, then holds end_hold_sec on its last line. `vignettes` pause the roll at a fraction of it (`at`) for hold_sec: the roll fades out over fade_sec, the vignette's `scene` (Cinematics' in-engine scene) is instanced behind it and its id emitted (CreditsRoll.vignette_started), then the roll fades back in and the scene is freed. A vignette whose `scene` is empty or missing is passed over (no stop on black). Holding ui_accept runs the roll fast_factor times faster (never through a vignette). Once the credits have been seen in full (flag credits_seen), holding ui_cancel for skip_hold_sec ends them. When they end, `next_scene` opens (the post-credits scene; empty: the title). The Lead (11-03): the credits hold facts only: the title; the original score, art and code made for this project; Made with Godot Engine and its MIT licence notice (required), with FreeType's credit; the OFL font credits with their licence. No person on the project is named yet: the human decides that later, in the 'optional' Made by section, which is left out of the roll while its lines are empty (add a name line to show it). A 'notice' section's lines are licence text, set small; any line wraps and takes its own height. hint.band_pad: the black band under the hint starts this many px above it, so the climbing lines pass beneath it.
